metadata.description: SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER -- NOT live-captured. Relocated 2026-08-06 from testdata/mock-responses/sensors/get_device_sensors.json (left in place, unmodified, for CI existence checks and the default non-override test run -- this copy is the one actually loaded by TestGeneratedGetDeviceSensorsByDeviceV1 via the bypass mechanism in tests/bypass_fixture_helper_test.go). The 2026-08-05 ledger audit (tests/verified-endpoints.json unverified[]) flagged the prior body as SUSPICIOUS: both uuids were textbook hand-typed sequential-hex placeholders (spelling out 1,2,3,4...5,6,7,8,9,0), not gofakeit.UUID() output, and the timestamps were suspiciously round 5-minute increments. This copy keeps the same overall shape (total_results + results array of {uuid, name, value, last_executed_at}) but uses deliberately-obvious placeholder values with no claim of ever having been captured against a live tenant. GET /api/mdm/devices/{deviceUuid}/sensors (V1, mdmv1 device-scoped sensor list).
